reply: Zero Inspector Kit 是 Zero Labs 为 Flutter 应用打造的一款应用内调试工具包。它以内嵌方式运行在你的 Flutter 应用中，可实时查看网络请求、日志、本地数据库、性能指标（FPS、内存、CPU）以及 UI 组件树。它以 pub.dev 包形式分发，采用 GPL-3.0 开源协议。了解更多：https://pub.dev/packages/zero_inspector_kit

Zero Inspector Kit is an in-app debugging toolkit for Flutter apps by Zero Labs. It runs inside your Flutter app and lets you inspect network requests, logs, local database, performance metrics (FPS, memory, CPU), and the UI widget tree in real time. It is distributed on pub.dev and open sourced under GPL-3.0. Learn more: https://pub.dev/packages/zero_inspector_kit

Invoice Zero 是 Zero Labs 用 Flutter 打造的闭源商业产品（非开源）发票/收据/报价管理应用。
【功能分档】
免费可用：发票/报价/收据的创建与编辑、电子签名与盖章、多语言（中/英）、数据完全本地存储（无云端）、多货币、税率与折扣计算、PDF 模板选择。
非会员但有限制：PDF 导出/分享每月仅 5 次（共享额度，超额弹升级提示，可获赠额外次数）。
会员(Pro)专属：预览（Preview）功能，以及无限导出/分享、去水印等权益。

Invoice Zero is a closed-source, commercial Flutter app (not open source) by Zero Labs for invoice, receipt, and quote management.
[Feature tiers]
Free: create/edit invoices, quotes and receipts; electronic signature & stamp; multi-language (EN/ZH); local-only storage (no cloud); multi-currency; tax & discount; PDF template selection.
Free-but-limited: PDF export/share limited to 5 times per month (shared quota; over-limit shows an upgrade dialog; bonus exports may be granted).
Pro-only: Preview feature, plus unlimited exports/shares, no-watermark, and other Pro benefits.
[Closed-beta pricing] Only two USD plans: Monthly US$5.99/mo, Yearly US$54.99/yr (~US$4.58/mo; yearly cheaper). No other tiers. Access by invite only, not public app stores. For current access/pricing refer to invoicezero.net. Source code is not public.

Flutter Agent Kit 是 Zero Labs 推出的、工具无关的 Flutter / Dart 开发引导套件，核心是单一真相源 AGENTS.md（外加 CodeBuddy 的 SKILL.md、references/ 文档和 Dart/Python 辅助脚本）。安装：先 git clone https://github.com/zero-labsco/flutter-agent-kit.git，然后在套件目录运行 dart run install.dart（Dart）或 python install.py（Python）。安装脚本会自动检测并接入 CodeBuddy（~/.codebuddy/skills/）、Claude Code（~/.claude/skills/）、Cursor（.cursorrules）或 GitHub Copilot（.github/copilot-instructions.md）；可用 -t <tool> 指定单一工具、-p <项目路径> 指定目标项目。采用 MIT 开源协议。

Flutter Agent Kit is a tool-agnostic Flutter / Dart development guidance kit by Zero Labs. Its core is AGENTS.md (single source of truth), plus a CodeBuddy SKILL.md wrapper, reference docs under references/, and Dart/Python helper scripts. Install: git clone https://github.com/zero-labsco/flutter-agent-kit.git, then run 'dart run install.dart' (Dart) or 'python install.py' (Python) from the kit folder. The installer auto-detects and wires into CodeBuddy (~/.codebuddy/skills/), Claude Code (~/.claude/skills/), Cursor (.cursorrules), or GitHub Copilot (.github/copilot-instructions.md); use -t <tool> to target one tool, -p <path> for a project. MIT licensed.
